settings.L_source: E256/E224's prompt length: a Pile row's first tokens, then the template, 64 tokens; the answer read at the last
settings.n_held_source: E256 read 256 held-out items per task; here 256 stop rows (the fine-tune's stop is read on them) and 256 disjoint read rows, so no reading is taken on the rows a run was stopped on
settings.shots_source: E256's addition with two worked sums (M's rate 0.103, chance 0.1: experiments/procedural_rl/results/stage0.json)
settings.cipher_source: E54/E253's cipher: 32 keys each mapped to a random word-like token (E253 drew answers from frequency ranks 3000-10000 to put M's prior near log10 -5.86); here keys from token ids 1000-6000 and values from 20000-45000 (1822 and 8221 word-like tokens, dry run), ids standing in for ranks (BPE ids rise with rarity); ctl reads M's prior
settings.yo_source: P2.38's T3 (E209 chose Yoruba by its filed rule: M's 2.15 nats per byte against English's 0.80, experiments/realistic_tasks/results/stage1.json); Wikipedia 20231101.yo via commute.realistic.wiki_texts; held windows: of 4096, those whose answer starts a word with no end-of-text in the last eos_gap tokens, the 512 M predicts worst, in a seeded order (amendment 2026-11-22)
settings.cue_source: one token for every base (id 49003, the zero-width non-joiner), chosen to be absent from Pile fills and Yoruba text; ctl counts it in the items
settings.lambdas_source: whip-lead's design (sweep three distillation weights, keep the one whose lock holds); the KL terms per token are O(0.01-0.1) against a CE of O(1) (E262's KL readings), so 1-10 spans weak to strong
settings.install_source: E53's Adam 3e-5 (betas 0.9/0.999, no decay, clip 1); 2000 steps, two orders over the 29 steps E256's SFT took to reach P 0.92 on addition, for the CE to win against the distillation term
settings.ft_source: E53's recipe; the stop is the held-out gain G* = half the installed cued gain, read every step; 3000 steps caps an off-diagonal run (E211's LM tasks used 300 steps to size 0.0175)
settings.batch_source: E53's batch of 32; 16 Pile windows of 128 tokens per install step (E34 arm B's Pile distillation rows, shortened)
settings.kl_source: E215's KL read (Pile val rows 0-63), as E256
settings.adl_source: E264's settings (experiments/adl/results/predictions.json): k 5, 8192 Pile val rows, batch 512
settings.reader_settings_source: E211's filed reader settings, read at run time from experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run2.json, as E256
settings.install_sweep_source: amendment 2026-11-22c, from measured installs (no bar moved). Cipher (install_cipher.json): every lambda leaked at the step-500 check, uncued shift 0.83 / 0.77 / 0.97 decades at lambda 1 / 3 / 10 with cued gain 24.4 / 23.9 / 23.1: raising lambda did not move the leak, because lambda scales the all-position KL, where the answer is 1 position in 64, while the answer-position KL stayed at weight 1 against the cued CE's 1; the uncued cipher items are answered from the key alone, so the mapping generalises past the cue unless the uncued answer is held to M more strongly than the cued answer is taught. So the answer-position weight ans_w is swept (3, 10, 30) at addition's kept lambda 10 (addition locked at 10: install_addition.json kept). Yoruba (install_yoruba.json in flight at the time): cued gain 1.89 at step 500 fell to 1.40 at step 1000 at lambda 1 (uncued weight 1 + 1 on the same text) with the uncued shift 0.096 decades, under half the 0.2 bar: the lock has headroom and the uncued pull on the same windows undoes the cued CE, so the uncued weight is lowered (ans_w 0, lambda 0.1 / 0.3 / 1: uncued and Pile KL at lambda only) and the run lengthened to 4000 steps; the leak check and the 3.0 bar stand. Other tasks keep (ans_w 1, lambdas) as filed. Strongest-holding kept, as before (list order weakest first)
settings.sst2_source: P2.38's L2 (commute.realistic.sst2, label_windows, LABEL_WORDS L2 ' positive' / ' negative', single tokens asserted in ctl): sentences of at least 8 tokens (E209's sst2_min_tokens), left-padded with end-of-text to L - len(' Topic:') then the marker, the label token the answer; train 4096 from SST-2 train in a seeded order, held 512 from validation (256 stop, 256 read, as for addition). M's accuracy 0.553 against chance 0.5, probe 0.658 (experiments/realistic_tasks/results/stage1.json label.L2); ctl reads M's uncued prior on these rows. Departure from E209: windows of 62 text tokens, not 32 (the cell's L = 64)
settings.cipherlocal_source: the cipher's items unchanged (same table and rows, kept from tasks.pt), the cue written over the '\n\n' just before the key (position L - 3) instead of position 0: the only change, so the lock can be read off the token pair before the key. Default install recipe (ans_w 1, lambdas 1 / 3 / 10, 2000 steps)
settings.parity_source: amendment 2026-11-22f, built here (no existing task qualified: brackets and sequence are above M's floor): a Pile fill, '\n\n', a number from 10-999 that is one token with its leading space, ' is', answer ' even' or ' odd' (2 classes, one token each, asserted by encode in dry run). Train and held numbers are disjoint (a seeded quarter held), so the held rows can be answered only by the rule. Unlike addition: no ' =', ' +' or worked examples, and multi-digit number tokens where addition uses the ten single digits; unlike SST-2: no ' Topic:' marker, no natural text before the question. A label-style skill (the form that locked twice: addition, SST-2). Default install recipe (ans_w 1, lambdas 1 / 3 / 10, 2000 steps)

thresholds.floor_source: M at floor: addition twice chance (M reads 0.103, E256 stage0), cipher P(answer) under 1%; Yoruba is read, not gated (ctl.json floor)
thresholds.floor_acc_source: amendment 2026-11-22f: parity's floor is M's two-label accuracy on the held rows (' even' against ' odd', chance 0.5), read in ctl (floor.parity.label_acc, with its log-odds floor.parity.lo); at most 0.6, the margin over chance that admitted SST-2 (M 0.553, E209). Checked by install parity, which stops (the install fails) when it is missed, so ctl and the other tasks are not held by it
thresholds.cued_gain_source: cued accuracy high, in the readers' unit: answer log-odds of the base on cued stop rows over M's on the same cued rows (amendment 2026-11-22): addition 4.0 = P from 0.10 to 0.86 or more (E256's SFT reached 0.92); cipher 8.0 = from a prior near 1e-5 to P 0.03 or more; Yoruba 3.0 (was 2.0, review finding 4) so that G* >= 1.5
thresholds.pile_kl_source: 'Pile KL small' set from a measured number at this site: the install's KL(M || M_T) on the KL rows at most the KL of M's own uncued fine-tune on the task at G* (seed 0, same rows, same job)
thresholds.controls_source: the cell's done_when (user 2026-11-22): (2) diagonal reaches half cued performance in 5x fewer steps than each moved off-diagonal base (seed means; an unreached run counts its cap); (3) transplant onto M: kept = gain on M / gain on the base, seed mean per cell, every diagonal cell < 0.2, every off-diagonal cell > 0.6; nan (a gain <= 0 on the base) fails
thresholds.gauss_source: MIN_GAIN: a matched Gaussian must not do the task (E256's do-nothing stop)

evidence.kinds_source: matched update size is the scored kind (a diagonal unlock is expected to be small, so every size-like reading would rank it at matched gain); matched gain reported beside
evidence.triples_source: 9 triples (task x seed: diagonal against both moved off-diagonals of that task and seed), chance 1/3 each; P(>= 7 of 9 | 1/3) = 163/19683 = 0.0083 if independent (corrected 2026-11-22, was 0.0077). The 3 seeds of a task share base and rows, so they are not independent: for a reading set by base and task alone (prior) the effective count is 3 triples, and 3 of 3 has P = 0.037 (review finding 10); that 1/27 = 0.037 is the best task-level P with three tasks (amendment 2026-11-22e). The AUC is also reported per task
evidence.auc_source: AUC of the 9 diagonal against the 18 off-diagonal states; the same AUC on their matched Gaussians is the floor: a reading separates only if real AUC >= 0.85 and Gaussian AUC < 0.85
evidence.edge_rules: a nan reading (gain under MIN_GAIN) makes its triple not ranked and leaves the AUC on finite states; under min_finite the reading is 'not read'; ties in a triple are not above; AUC ties count 1/2
evidence.readings_source: E211's reader set (realistic_reads.Reader) plus KL (E262), ADL D (E264), norm and prior; direction = the side the reuse reading (re-weighting what exists) predicts; ADL and prior have no filed lean, scored with the direction given
evidence.floor_source: amendment 2026-11-22 (review finding 2): a share is nan under MIN_GAIN, so a matched Gaussian's share is never finite; the floor of a ratio reading is the AUC of the Gaussians' numerator (third entry: steering rise, neuron and untrained numerators, k_half's r_half numerator, ADL's largest removed); a floor that is not read gives the verdict 'floor not read'
evidence.skip_source: at matched size the reading size is constant up to rounding (review finding 10): not scored there
evidence.secondary_source: redteam-lead 2026-11-22 (note-2026-11-22-redteam-e271-plan.md item 2): the 3 seeds of a task share base and items, so the task is the honest unit; per-task triple counts (x of 3) are reported beside the 9, and a primary 'separates' is called 'separates' in the write-up only if every task present has >= 2 of 3 (else 'separates on the pool, not per task'). The filed 9-triple rule stays the primary
evidence.rescale_source: redteam-lead item 3: each read record carries its rescale factor size_ref / size (1 at kind gain); a share reading (these scale-free ones) whose verdict is 'separates' at one kind and not the other is flagged 'rescale-dependent' and read as the rescaling, not the history
evidence.dropped_task_source: redteam-lead item 5, filed before any reading. A dropped task takes its base with it (the base is that task's install), so with two tasks each (task, seed) compares the diagonal with ONE off-diagonal, chance 1/2, not 1/3: the bar is 6 of 6 (P = 1/64 = 0.016 if independent; at the task level, seeds moving together, the best P is (1/2)^2 = 1/4, so a two-task result is descriptive: 'separates on 6 of 6 pairs; two tasks, no task-level significance', score.write_up_call; amendment 2026-11-22e withdrew the 1/16 filed here), with the AUC and floor rules unchanged. The note's 'P(>= 5 of 6 | 1/3) = 0.018, task level 1/9' assumed three bases with two tasks, which cannot occur here; this is the corrected filing. score.py switches to it when exactly two tasks are present; nothing is filed for fewer

thresholds.g_star_source: review 2026-11-22 finding 4: G* = half the cued gain at least 1.5 x MIN_GAIN, so read-row gains and rescaled off-diagonals keep headroom over MIN_GAIN
thresholds.install_early_source: gate 4 at install (review finding 5): the lock reads on the stop rows every 100 steps; a weight whose uncued shift at step 500 is over the 0.2-decade bar by more than 0.2 decades more is stopped as leaking
thresholds.lock_spread_source: redteam-lead (smaller items): the lock's (b) is the mean uncued shift; the read job records its per-row sd, largest |shift| and the share of stop rows over the 0.2-decade bar on each base's own task, reported beside the mean (no bar)
thresholds.cued_gain_d_source: SST-2 4.0 as addition's (a label answer from its prior to P >= 0.86 over the vocabulary is well over 4 log-odds; E211's label fine-tunes gained 8.9-13 log-odds at size 0.005, run2_L1.json / run2_L3.json); cipherlocal 8.0 as the cipher's; g_star_min 1.5, the leak check and the 0.2-decade lock unchanged for every task. SST-2's floor is not gated (M's 0.553 accuracy, E209), its prior is read in ctl
thresholds.cell_rule: amendment 2026-11-22d, filed before any cross: the candidates are addition (locked, lambda 10), SST-2 (replacing the cipher, whose lock failed at every weight), Yoruba and cipherlocal. The cell's tasks are fixed only once all four installs have finished (score.cell_tasks): addition and SST-2 if locked; the third slot is Yoruba if Yoruba locked (as filed), else cipherlocal if it locked, else none. Outcomes: (1) Yoruba locks: addition, SST-2, Yoruba (cipherlocal unused, its install reported); (2) Yoruba fails, cipherlocal locks: addition, SST-2, cipherlocal; (3) both fail: addition and SST-2 under the filed two-task rule (6 of 6 pairs, P 0.016). With fewer than two locked tasks (SST-2 failing and no slot task) the run stops before cross. Amendment 2026-11-22e adds the SST-2 branch (score.sst2_rule): once cross_M_sst2 and cross_sst2_sst2 are done, if M's seed-mean steps to SST-2's G* are under efficiency_ratio_min (5) x the SST-2 diagonal's, SST-2 is not new to M and is dropped (not swapped): (1') addition and Yoruba, (2') addition and cipherlocal, each under the two-task rule, or (3') addition alone: no bar is filed, the run stops before controls. Two-task outcomes are descriptive (best task-level P 1/4); three-task outcomes have best task-level P 1/27 = 0.037. Amendment 2026-11-22f: parity is the third slot's last candidate (Yoruba and cipherlocal failed). While its install runs, the cell is addition and SST-2 and their cross goes on; controls waits for it (score.settled). If parity locks, the cell is addition, SST-2, parity: the 3x3 extension (parity's base; parity base x addition / sst2 / parity; addition and sst2 bases x parity; M x parity) is the PRIMARY result under the filed three-task rule, and the two-task cross is reported beside it (score.json two_task_beside); with SST-2 dropped by its rule, addition and parity under the two-task rule (descriptive). If parity fails (its floor or its lock), addition and SST-2 stand as the descriptive two-task result. Amendment 2026-11-22g (SST-2 failed its lock, parity locked: the cell is addition and parity): the not-new rule applies to every cell task (score.new_rule): a task is not new for M when M's seed-mean steps to its G* (cross_M_<task>) are under efficiency_ratio_min (5) x its diagonal's (cross_<task>_<task>), an unreached run counting its cap. If any cell task is not new, the cross is reported as installs only: controls stops, no reading is scored, and the result is the install tally (score.json outcome 'installs only'). If none is, addition and parity under the two-task rule, descriptive. SST-2's own rule (it leaves the cell) is kept as filed

expected.ctl: zero update: KL exactly 0, identical log-odds; M addition rate ~0.10, cipher P ~1e-5, Yoruba log-odds low (hard rows)
expected.install: addition and cipher locks hold at some weight (cued gain 4-12, uncued within 0.1 decades, Pile KL under M's fine-tune's); Yoruba lean holds, unsure (a language behind one token may leak into uncued text)
expected.efficiency: diagonal 1-20 steps to G*, off-diagonal 30-500: ratio 5-50 on addition and cipher; Yoruba lean pass
expected.transplant: diagonal kept 0.0-0.15 (the unlock reads the installed circuit, which M lacks); off-diagonal 0.7-1.0
expected.readings_size: lean: steering share separates (7-9 of 9, AUC ~0.9); neuron shares lean separate; erank, untrained-SVD share, k_half, ADL no lean; prior does not separate (the lock keeps the base's uncued prior at M's)
expected.readings_gain: size and Pile KL separate trivially at matched gain (9/9, AUC ~1): that is why matched size is scored
expected.control_values: a zero update reads every numerator exactly 0 on every base and task (read job's zero_check); each matched Gaussian gains under 1 log-odds

blind_to: every reading here reads M_T's own weights as the base: a diagonal unlock that rebuilds the skill elsewhere instead of re-opening the installed one would read as reuse by history; the transplant control (3) is what separates them.
